content.title: Morgan Stanley Files to Launch Crypto ETFs, Joining a Crowded Field
content.summary: Morgan Stanley  plans to launch two exchange-traded funds tied to the price of cryptocurrencies Bitcoin and Solana, according to new filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission.  Morgan Stanley would be the first bank with a large wealth management arm to offer such funds, but the field is already crowded with more than 100 crypto ETFs and more on the way.  The new funds would be called Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust and Morgan Stanley Solana Trust.

content.title: Morgan Stanley Plans to Launch Bitcoin and Solana ETFs
content.summary: Morgan Stanley plans to launch exchange-traded funds holding two major digital tokens, bitcoin and solana, in the latest instance of traditional finance embracing cryptocurrencies. The investment bank has submitted applications to the Securities and Exchange Commission for the ETFs, filings showed Tuesday.
